selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results, including elevated C-reactive protein and surfactant protein D levels, along with the lack of response to antibiotics and the presence of lymphocytosis in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, support the diagnosis of ICI-induced pneumonitis.

rejected.label: Immune-related adverse event (irAE)
rejected.why: While the patient did experience an immune-related adverse event, the specific diagnosis of ICI-induced pneumonitis is more precise and better explains the patient's symptoms and laboratory results.
